data.long_meaning: Derived from the Hebrew name Micahel, which means 'who is like God?'. In Christian tradition, the archangel Michael is considered the greatest of all angels and a powerful warrior against Satan. He is also believed to be the guardian of the Church and the protector of Israel. The name Mechel is a modern variation of the name Michael, emphasizing the meaning 'God of Mercy'.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine protection and mercy.

Mechel is also remembered for his role in the synod of 1351, which affirmed the hesychast teachings and established them as orthodox doctrine.
